component.name: Rex GTK
component.summary: A GTK client for the Rex terminal multiplexer

description.p: Shows the sessions on your Rex server, with each session's windows as tabs and their splits, zoom and floating panes kept in step with the server. Terminals are drawn on the GPU with Ghostty's renderer.
An unofficial client, not affiliated with Rex.
First version: sessions, tabs, splits, mouse and clipboard, Rex key bindings and remote control.
